title: Apexspace intro pillars
description: A charcoal band with a big light uppercase statement (34 → 60px) and, well below it, three pillars: each under a full-width hairline, a thin line icon, a two-line uppercase sub-head and a short paragraph. Three equal columns on desktop, stacked on phones.
notes: pass thin line icons (lucide with strokeWidth 1 suits it); they are drawn at 40px in the text colour
